details:
The last build is even more worser. I cannot sign properly. It's VERY frustrating and i am already start begging: Please fix many problems in VRChat lately. I will sum up the problems now, also old ones which are not solved:

- Right controller switched randomly between RC Touch and RC Position functions. Touch is for gestures, Position is for Jump / movement. This happens when Vive Advanced Control is enabled. This started since build 984, where you fixed double-thumb problem. But unfortunately, it broke another functions on Right Controller touchpad of WMR.
Let's collect reported problems:
https://vrchat.canny.io/bug-reports/p/right-controller-touchpad-bug-in-build-984
https://vrchat.canny.io/bug-reports/p/wmr-jolt-forward-and-rh-gesture-stuck (yep - same problem)
Weird enough, when i turn off Vive Advanced Control, right hand gestures worked much better, and much less chance stuck in Position mode. Still i dislike the "memory" gesture, without reset to idle hand. The movement is one-speed, makes akward to run around in some worlds!
- Vive Advanced Control broke triggers when turned off/on. When i do it, i noticed the fist gesture is not more working. I cannot restore it by turn on/off. When turned off, fist gesture worked. Only full restart VRChat will restore the fist gesture and i can use triggers for fist.

Two problems here makes signing even more harder. OMG! How can i sign normal with my deaf friends if we have two major problems here? The Vive Advanced Controller bug is still not solved for months. The random swap mode in right touchpad is new problems. 
And looking by turn on/off VAC, i noticed the problems without VAC are less worser: much less random switching Touch/Position. Don't tell me VAC is much more broken now since last update?
But without VAC signing is not great due too many memory gesturing and fixed walking speed. 

Fix VAC system ASAP!
title: VRChat (build 984) is bugged for WMR users.
